note: The Critical pull_request_target path from `run-tests-cloud.yml` was judged false: it runs on `types: [labeled]` only when a maintainer applies `tests:run-cloud`, at the labelled head commit, so it holds as a maintainer-approved Medium at most; the High `lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2` path was judged overstated: the job holds no secret and the repository default token is read-only (the `GITHUB_TOKEN Permissions` block of a recent run log), so a compromised action only runs code on the runner, Medium at most.

paths.pending: a checkout of the pull request head SHA written with a fallback (`head.sha || github.sha`, `head.sha || github.ref`, `event_name == 'pull_request_target' && head.sha || github.ref`) is not read as a pinned head commit, although under pull_request_target it is always the head SHA, so the maintainer-approved path holds at High instead of Medium.
